title: OneDrive: sync up to 1 million items on macOS
summary: Hold: Microsoft Support already publishes the Mac preview's hardware and configuration requirements, but the briefing tells administrators to wait for them. The roadmap dates, Message Center rollout details and Tier preference are supported; the Intune navigation needs only a minor clarification.

claims.claim: The printed Intune path reaches the Property list file setting in a macOS Preference file profile.
claims.quote: Select Devices > Manage devices > Configuration > Create > New policy. Platform: Select macOS. Profile type: Select Templates > Preference file. In Configuration settings, configure your settings: ... Property list file
claims.fix: Expand the path to 'Devices > Manage devices > Configuration > Create > New policy > macOS > Templates > Preference file > Create > Basics > Configuration settings > Property list file', following https://learn.microsoft.com/intune/device-configuration/templates/configure-preference-file-macos. The omitted Basics page only collects a name and description; this is not a wrong navigation route.

claims.claim: Detailed hardware and configuration requirements for the Mac preview have not yet been published, so candidates should be checked once Microsoft publishes them.
claims.quote:
Windows 11, Windows Server 2025, or macOS Golden Gate 27.
Memory: 8 GB RAM minimum (16 GB recommended).
Storage: Solid-state drive (SSD) required.
Processor: Intel i5 / AMD Ryzen 5 or later, Snapdragon X Plus or Apple silicon.
claims.fix: Replace the claims that hardware requirements are unpublished in Cost and licensing and the cost rationale with: 'Microsoft Support publishes the preview hardware and configuration requirements in Restrictions and limitations in OneDrive and SharePoint.' Link that sentence and add https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/office/restrictions-and-limitations-in-onedrive-and-sharepoint-64883a5d-228e-48f5-b3d2-eb39e07630fa to sources. Replace the Before rollout bullet with: 'Check each candidate Mac against the published preview requirements in Restrictions and limitations in OneDrive and SharePoint.' Remove the first Open questions bullet, which asks for those already published requirements. Keep the narrower statement that the supplied notice and roadmap do not give their values.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not published a local disk-space capacity required specifically for larger synced libraries under this preview.
claims.quote: Searched: OneDrive macOS 1 million items sync preview hardware requirements memory storage processor. Read Mac deployment, SharePoint limits and Support preview requirements: SSD is specified, but no local disk-capacity amount for a million-item library.
